title: Fateful Confrontation
next_chapter_hook: At the moment Chen Ji believed he had seen through all the Heavenly Secrets, Chen Jie uttered those words that made his soul scatter - the Heavenly Eye is merely a puppet of an even higher existence, and the true Chess Player is watching all of us right now.

text.content: The world seemed to freeze in that instant. Chen Ji gazed at the face before him, identical to his own, at those eyes both familiar and alien. His heart churned with monstrous waves. He had countless times deduced possible enemies in his mind, calculated the trajectory of fate, yet never imagined his deepest fear would manifest in such a way - a bloodline-connected mirror image, a child of destiny chosen by Heavenly Dao.

dialogue.content: Chen Jie... twin name, mirror catastrophe. Ha, what a fine cycle of Heavenly Dao, what a destined inevitability.
dialogue.emotion: 冷笑，心中却是惊涛骇浪

dialogue.content: Chen Jie stood with hands behind his back, his black robe fluttering dramatically in the Void. A trace of pity appeared on that face identical to Chen Ji's: 'We were originally one, split by Heavenly Dao into yin and yang extremes. Ten thousand years ago, Master divided us, splitting the seed of destiny in two - the yang bearer carrying the concept of breaking the局, the yin bearer carrying the responsibility of Heavenly Fate. You think you're resisting fate, but you don't realize every act of resistance is reinforcing fate's foundation.'
dialogue.emotion: 悲悯中带着不容置疑的威严

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly, but his expression remained unruffled. He slowly raised the fragment in his hand, the Tianji Record's light flowing around his fingertips: 'Chen Xuan... no, should I call him Master or Ancestor? He said Heavenly Fate can be defied, that destiny is a shackle, that as long as one finds all the fragments of the Tianji Record, they can jump out of the chessboard and become the Chess Player. Do you believe these words?'

dialogue.content: Chen Jie laughed lightly, that laughter utterly different from Chen Ji's low and deep tone, carrying a desolation of having seen through worldly affairs: 'Believe? I don't need to believe. Master's tragedy lies in his naivety, thinking splitting destiny could defeat Heavenly Dao. But he forgot, yin and yang are originally one, you contain me, I contain you. The more you want to break all this, the more you're adding bricks to fate. Look—'

text.content: Chen Jie waved his hand, and a massive chessboard phantom emerged in the Void. Black and white pieces interweaved in a complex pattern, and at the edge of the chessboard, two identical pieces were locked in mutual slaughter. Chen Ji saw clearly - those two pieces, one representing himself, one representing Chen Jie, and above, a massive eye coldly observed everything.

dialogue.content: You think you're arranging the world, believe you've left nothing to chance, think you can deceive everyone with your 'waste' persona. Chen Jie's voice suddenly turned ice-cold, 'But every time you use the Tianji Record, every time you consume Heavenly Fate Value, you're feeding that eye! It needs seers, needs fragments of destiny, needs people like you constantly 'peering' into the future. You think you're resisting, but you're actually its most faithful sacrifice!'

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. He remembered what Mo Xiansheng had said - the Tianji Record is a piece Heavenly Dao placed on the board. But hearing it from Chen Jie's mouth felt entirely different. This was not a warning, but an居高临下的 declaration, a mockery of a predetermined ending. He slowly closed his eyes, and when he opened them again, his gaze had turned ice-cold.

dialogue.content: You're right. Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, 'If Heavenly Dao needs a sacrifice, then I'll willingly be that sacrifice. But not in the way you imagined - becoming part of destiny, but smashing the entire chessboard, along with that eye.'

text.content: He raised the Tianji Record in his hand, this time no longer a fragment - in the chess game of destiny, he had collected enough fragments. The complete Tianji Record bloomed with dazzling light in his palm, that light resonating with the Heavenly Fate power on Chen Jie, yet presenting a completely different phenomenon.

choice.prompt: Facing Chen Jie's fatalism and the truth of Heavenly Dao, Chen Ji must make a choice - this is the crucial step to break the shackles of destiny.

choices.text: Break the局 with force, directly confront
choices.description: Use the complete Tianji Record to demonstrate the concept of breaking the局, attack to defend, try to tear the bonds of destiny through confrontation.
choices.visible_reward: Tianji Record resonance, may interrupt Chen Jie's Heavenly Fate connection
choices.risk_hint: The opponent is a ten-thousand-year-old existence, with unfathomable depths

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly propelled the Tianji Record. The complete Tianji Record burst forth with blinding light, colliding head-on with Chen Jie's Heavenly Fate power. A thunderous roar exploded in the Void, the two forces intertwining and tearing in mid-air.

dialogue.content: Chen Jie took a step back, a trace of shock flickering in his eyes: 'You actually dared to do this... but do you think this can hurt me? We are one, your attacks will only bind us more tightly together!'

choices.description: Temporarily sheathe the blade, try to extract more information about Heavenly Dao's truth from Chen Jie.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more intelligence about Heavenly Dao's puppets
choices.risk_hint: May be seen as weak, giving the opponent an opening

text.content: Chen Ji收起天机录的光芒，脸上的杀意逐渐敛去，取而代之的是一种更深沉的审视。他缓缓开口：'你说得对，我们本是一体。既然如此，你我何必非要分个你死我活？不如……坐下来谈谈？'

dialogue.content: Chen Jie narrowed his eyes, as if reassessing this 'self' before him: 'Interesting... you're more懂得隐忍 than Master. But negotiation requires筹码, what do you have that I want?'

choices.description: Risk trying to reunite the yin and yang halves, use chaotic power to impact Heavenly Dao's shackles.
choices.visible_reward: If successful, will obtain chaotic power beyond Heavenly Dao
choices.risk_hint: No one has attempted this in ten thousand years, success rate unknown

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly burst into laughter, that laughter carrying a near-mad determination: 'You say every act of resistance reinforces fate? Then I'll do the opposite - since yin and yang are one, I'll reunite us, let's see what Heavenly Dao can do about it!'

dialogue.content: Chen Jie's expression changed dramatically, showing genuine panic for the first time: 'You're insane! The consequence of failed fusion is soul scatter, both of us will be completely annihilated!'

text.content: Just as the three-way choice remained deadlocked, Chen Jie suddenly收敛 all momentum. Those eyes, identical to Chen Ji's, flickered with complex light. He slowly spoke, his voice carrying an indefinable meaning: 'You're clever, cleverer than Master, cleverer than me. But your greatest mistake is thinking you've seen through everything.'

dialogue.content: Do you think the Heavenly Eye is the final enemy? Think you can break fate's shackles just by defeating it? Chen Jie laughed, that smile carrying a trace of sarcasm, 'Chen Ji, you're too naive. The Heavenly Eye is merely a puppet of a higher existence. And the true Chess Player...'

text.content: He suddenly paused, his gaze penetrating the Void, as if seeing something even he found terrifying. After a moment, Chen Jie收回目光, looking at Chen Ji with something deeper in his eyes: 'When you truly collect all the fragments of the Tianji Record, when you stand before the Heavenly Eye, you'll understand... what true despair is.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stared fixedly at Chen Jie's eyes, trying to read more information. But on that face identical to his own, there was only fathomless silence. He suddenly felt an unprecedented chill - he thought he was the Chess Player, thought the Tianji Record was the key to breaking the局, yet in the eyes of that higher existence, he might not even qualify as a piece.
dialogue.emotion: 内心震动，面上却越发平静

text.content: Chen Jie turned away, his black robe fluttering in the Void. His voice came from the distance, carrying an elusive emotion: 'This round, I'll let you win. Not because you're stronger than me, but because you're more worthy of being the seed that breaks destiny. See you in the next volume, Chen Ji - I hope you're still alive by then.'

When Chen Jie's figure vanished into the Void, Chen Ji stood alone, the Tianji Record in his hand still glowing faintly. He lowered his head to look at those ancient runes, suddenly realizing he had never examined them so carefully. Mo Xiansheng said the Tianji Record is a key, but if even the Heavenly Eye is merely a puppet, what door can this key actually open?

He took a deep breath and tucked the Tianji Record into his chest. A self-deprecating curve appeared at the corner of his mouth: 'The true Chess Player is someone else? Hmph... this chaotic world, there's always a darker shade. But it doesn't matter, Chess Player or puppet, if Heavenly Dao wants to play, I'll play along.' He raised his head, his gaze penetrating the layers of Void, as if wanting to see the face of that higher existence: 'I Chen Ji never submit to fate, even if I must lose, I'll lose in spectacular fashion.'

In the distance, the Demonic Path army was still gathering. Chen Ji knew the true decisive battle had not yet begun. Heavenly Eye, fate's shackles, the higher Chess Player - these mysteries pressed down on his heart like mountains. But he had no retreat; from the moment he obtained the Tianji Record, there was no path back.

He turned to look in the direction behind him, where Su Qingyao and Ye Qing were waiting. The more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger fate's inevitable backlash - but he wasn't fighting alone. He had to quicken his pace, before that higher existence noticed him, before everything became irreversible. The end of this chapter is the beginning of the next storm. The true chess game has just begun.'
